qt: to the Commission Jean-Paul Garraud (PfE) Subject:

On 2 October 2026, the Commission announced a disbursement of EUR 2.9 billion to Ukraine, including EUR 800 million from the Ukraine Support Loan1. The Commission says the disbursement has come after fulfilment of reform steps set out in the Ukraine Plan. However, validating reforms alone is no guarantee that funds are traceable, nor that they will be used in line with the rules. The scale of the EU’s financial commitments calls for strict controls and transparency to enable Parliament and taxpayers to assess the outcome. 1.
What independent checks are carried out on the use of the funds disbursed, further to validation of the reform steps?

Since the Ukraine Facility entered into force, how much funding has been suspended, undergone financial corrections or been subject to a request for refund as a result of anomalies or suspected fraud – with a distinction made between those cases and deductions related to unfulfilled reforms?
Will the Commission publish a consolidated report on audits, anomalies identified and action taken? What is the timeline for publishing those reports?
